final_message:
Implemented all three functions in `src/diff.ts`. All tests pass (`npm test`: 3/3).

- `diffLines`: front-built greedy edit script; it precomputes suffix-LCS lengths (`dp[i][j]` = LCS of `a[i:]`, `b[j:]`) and deletes the next `a` line only when it doesn't reduce that LCS, per the tie-break rule. Verified `["x","y"]→["y","z"]` yields `[del x, keep y, add z]`.
- `renderDiff`: `"  "`/`"- "`/`"+ "` prefix per op, joined with `\n`, empty for no ops.
- `diffStats`: counts kept/deleted/added.
